operating_rules: CURRENT contains exactly one product train.
NEXT is ordered and contains only work with a concrete player outcome and acceptance contract.
FUTURE preserves sequenced product families without pretending they are active.
PARKED contains separated or dependency-blocked work and states the release condition.
DONE requires merged or otherwise immutable proof, not a planning claim.
The board does not create sub-beads, meta-audits, or a replacement House hierarchy.

current.title: Corpus-Coupled Causal Warning
current.outcome: Make one canonical lethal system legible through original, corpus-qualified warnings, inspection, repair feedback, and causal death prose.
scope: Flood Control Dam #3 Maintenance Room blue-button leak
four style receipts and hash-only corpus evidence
acceptance: WATER-LEVEL and I-MAINT-ROOM remain sole flood authorities
warnings fire once per threshold and never auto-escape or auto-repair
all player-visible prose exists in candidate files and passing style receipts
staging changes exactly 1actions.zil, zork1.zil, and corpus_causal_warning.zil
direct tests and source qualification pass

next.title: Parser Comprehension and Deep Affordances
next.outcome: Let reasonable player intentions reach existing world behavior instead of dying at vocabulary or object-routing gaps.
scope: high-value unsupported verbs and noun roles
acceptance: each added affordance reaches canonical actions or explicitly refuses
no universal intent engine or solution leakage
representative command families have gameplay tests and style receipts
boundaries: no command guessing that changes intent

next.title: Museum Intake and First Gallery
next.outcome: Turn discoveries into a persistent, navigable collection with physical custody and authored exhibit context.
acceptance: donated objects retain canonical identity and custody
gallery descriptions reveal only earned facts
intake, viewing, save, and restore are qualified
